package.author: ej-technologies GmbH
package.description: The Leading Java Profiler for Deep JVM Analysis

en-US.author: ej-technologies GmbH
en-US.description: The Leading Java Profiler for Deep JVM Analysis
en-US.longDescription: JProfiler bridges high-level analytics and low-level JVM data, delivering unmatched insights to solve your toughest performance problems, memory leaks, threading issues, and higher-level problems in technologies like JDBC, JPA, and more.
en-US.name: JProfiler 16
en-US.releaseNotes:
New features:
- MCP server: JVMs with a preloaded profiling agent are now discovered and can be attached to directly
- AI probe: Added support for Spring AI Bedrock and PostgresML embedding models
- JPA/ Hibernate probe: Added support for natural-id loads
- HTTP server probe: Asynchronous Servlet requests and Jetty 12 Handler requests are now recorded until they complete, including response status codes, errors, timeouts and redispatches
- gRPC probe: Canceled and expired server calls are now recorded
- JMS probe: Added support for JMSConsumer. receiveBody and receiveBodyNoWait
Bug fixes:
- Security: Updated the bundled JetBrains Runtime to address CVE-2026-91403 and CVE-2026-114820
- Security: Updated Guava to address CVE-2026-102554
- Security: Updated Expat to 2. 10. 0 to address CVE-2026-113351, CVE-2026-115506, CVE-2026-117610 and CVE-2026-118370
- Security: Updated zlib to 1. 4 to address CVE-2026-85091
- Security: Updated the MCP server dependency @hono/ node-server to address CVE-2026-118663
- MongoDB probe: Failed operations were included in performance recordings
- Cassandra probe: Cancelling asynchronous operations did not work correctly and later successful operations could be missing
- HTTP client probe: JDK HttpClient requests could be recorded twice or with conflicting results
- JDBC probe: Closed Oracle UCP connections were reported as leaks with Oracle JDBC driver 23. 26. 4.0. 0

zh-CN.description: 深度 JVM 分析的领先 Java 性能分析工具
zh-CN.longDescription: JProfiler 架起了高层分析与底层 JVM 数据之间的桥梁，提供无与伦比的洞察力，助您解决最棘手的性能问题、内存泄漏、线程问题，以及 JDBC、JPA 等技术中的高层级难题。
